assertions.assertion: The service is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The clinical indication documents a patient with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The diagnosis codes are R55 and G45.9

The ordering documentation states mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion
Authorization was missing rather than the service being unsupported
